baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated passive permission at word indices 3 and 6, bounded by the good or fit things at index 8.
baseline_models.mechanism: Permission works as a selective untying: a restraint is removed, but only for a class already qualified as good, fit, or wholesome. The construction therefore opens a bounded gate rather than letting appetite authorize itself.

activation_trace.role: The literal loosening of a knot supplies the release image and makes permission an act of removing a prior restraint.
The contrastive sense of what is good rather than foul supplies the quality boundary on what the release admits.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely answers with a list of permitted food.
changed_reading.after: The verse opens a controlled category: restraint is released only where the object is fit to pass through the gate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three teaching verbs at indices 10, 14, and 16, the hunting agents at 12-13, and their holding at index 20.
baseline_models.mechanism: A nested chain runs from divine teaching to human teaching to trained predatory agency. Training converts an agent capable of wounding or self-consumption into one that arrests its action and preserves a catch for another, so receivability arises through disciplined handoff.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge becoming disclosed to a knower supplies the repeated transmission chain from God through humans to trained agents.
The literal hunting-agent branch supplies predatory capacity as the material being governed.
The training of dogs for hunting supplies the practical conversion of appetite and pursuit into learned service.
Literal holding and detention supplies the stopping point that turns seizure into a handoff for the human recipient.

changed_reading.before: A trained animal is simply an approved hunting tool.
changed_reading.after: The catch becomes receivable through transmitted discipline: divine instruction is relayed into an agent that can stop its own predation and preserve the result for another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Eating at index 18 is followed by mentioning the name at 22-23, self-protection at 26, and rapid account at 30-31.
baseline_models.mechanism: Consumption is bracketed by attribution and reckoning. Naming identifies the authority under which the catch changes hands, while self-protection and rapid account prevent the beneficiary from treating permission as possession without answerability.

activation_trace.role: Literal taking of food supplies the beneficiary action whose legitimacy must still be governed.
Mention on the tongue supplies the overt act that keeps the source of authorization present at consumption.
The name as designation supplies explicit identification rather than an anonymous transfer into human use.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the beneficiary's active restraint after permission has been granted.
Speed as the opposite of delay makes accountability an immediate horizon rather than a remote afterthought.
Counting and accounting supplies the audit that closes the sequence opened by permission.

changed_reading.before: Naming and piety are ritual additions after the practical hunting rule.
changed_reading.after: The prey enters consumption through a named and auditable transfer; permission never severs benefit from attribution and account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places completion and binding before its first food permission. Binding and untying therefore form one gate mechanism: lawful release occurs inside an obligation that remains intact, not by escaping all bonds.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency supplies the demand that the governing bond be carried through whole.
Binding ends together supplies the material inverse of the focus verse's loosening and locates release within a tied structure.
A ratified covenant supplies the legal force that persists while a particular food restraint is opened.
The focus verse's untying supplies the selective release nested inside the context's completed bond.

structural_cues: 5:1 commands fulfillment of bonds immediately before a permission-and-exception sequence, and 5:4 repeats passive permission twice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion and binding at 5:1 and repeated release at 5:4; I infer that the release is administered within a still-binding covenant. A live alternative is that the contract command and food permission are adjacent legal topics without a shared material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Lawful means that a prohibition has simply disappeared.
changed_reading.after: Lawful means that a specific knot has been opened by the same authority whose larger bond the eater must continue to fulfill.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah contrasts carrion and what an uncontrolled predator has consumed with what can still be completed by human intervention. The focus then presents trained predators that hold rather than finish consuming. Status shifts from a static object label to the traceable and interruptible history of force acting on the object.

activation_trace.role: Carrion lacking a completing slaughter supplies the failed endpoint of an uncontrolled process.
The literal predatory beast supplies the nearby case in which animal appetite has already acted on the prey.
Completion of slaughter supplies the possibility of intercepting and regularizing an otherwise disqualifying death process.
The focus verse retains predatory agency but places it under a trained hunting function.
Holding supplies the interruption by which predation stops short of self-consumption and yields a handoff.

structural_cues: 5:3 lists uncontrolled death modes, reaches what a predator ate, and then marks a rescuable exception; 5:4 immediately turns to taught predators that preserve what they catch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed death processes, a possible completing intervention, and trained holding; I infer that controllability and handoff are the directional criterion joining them. A live alternative is that each rule is a separate status marker with no general process logic.

changed_reading.before: The trained hunter's credential by itself makes its catch lawful.
changed_reading.after: Lawfulness tracks an interruptible provenance: force must be trained to stop, preserve the object, and yield it for a named human reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context couples hunting with refusal to cross a limit and with directed cooperation, then depicts hostile hands extended and restrained. This makes the trained hunter's holding an instance of a wider rule: power becomes legitimate through learned inhibition and directed service.

activation_trace.role: Crossing a boundary into wrongdoing supplies the failure mode for pursuit or hostility that does not stop at its limit.
Assistance and mutual backing supply the positive redirection of capacity toward a shared good.
The extending or releasing of a hand supplies aggressive capacity in motion.
Restraint and prevention supply the decisive stopping action imposed on the extended hands.
Hunting training supplies a deliberate discipline placed upon pursuing force.
Holding supplies the trained inhibition that keeps seizure from becoming unbounded consumption.

structural_cues: 5:2 moves from hunting to non-transgression and directed cooperation; 5:11 later stages the same contrast as hands extended toward harm and then held back.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pursuit, boundary crossing, cooperation, extended hands, and restraint; I infer an ethical analogy between trained hunting power and governed human agency. A live alternative is that the human restraint scenes are independent of the technical hunting rule.

changed_reading.before: Holding prey is a technical sign that the animal performed correctly.
changed_reading.after: Holding is the moral technology of the scene: force is fit for service when it can stop before devouring or overrunning what lies before it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The purification instructions call substitute earth good or fit, aim at cleansing, and deny an aim of constriction. This revises the focus verse's good things from merely pleasant objects into materials fit to mediate a prescribed transition under real constraints.

activation_trace.role: Purity as removal of defilement supplies the intended state produced by the procedure.
The cleansing branch of goodness supplies fit earth as a valid substitute material rather than a sensory delicacy.
Constriction and difficulty supply the rejected aim, showing that procedural fitness can survive substitution.
The focus verse's good class receives the context's stronger sense of suitability for a governed bodily transition.

structural_cues: In 5:6, good or fit earth appears precisely when water is unavailable, and the stated purpose is purification without imposed constriction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root across food and substitute earth, plus purification and non-constriction; I infer a shared function of procedural fitness. A live alternative is that the adjective has independent domain-specific senses with no transfer back to food.

changed_reading.before: The good things are chiefly pleasant or legally permitted foods.
changed_reading.after: The good things are materials fit to cross a divinely governed bodily threshold; sensory appeal is only one possible aspect of that fitness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from a confirmed covenant heard and obeyed to instruction displaced and reminders forgotten. Against that failure, the focus verse's taught hunters retain training and hold its intended result. The animal training scene becomes an ironic model of faithful reception, enactment, and preservation of transmitted teaching.

activation_trace.role: The confirmed covenant supplies the human transmission bond within which hearing and action are expected to agree.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies reception that is meant to become action.
Willing compliance supplies the enacted completion of what was heard.
Deflection from a direction supplies the corruption of transmitted instruction by moving it off course.
Loss of remembrance supplies the failure to retain part of what had been transmitted.
The repeated loss of remembrance confirms that failed retention is a recurring contextual mechanism rather than an isolated event.
Repeated disclosed knowledge supplies the focus verse's multi-stage transmission chain.
Holding supplies a concrete image of retaining the taught outcome rather than losing or redirecting it.
Active remembrance supplies the human safeguard that keeps divine source and instruction present at the final handoff.

structural_cues: 5:4 repeats teaching three times; 5:7 pairs hearing with obedience; 5:13-14 repeat forgetting what had been recalled and add directional distortion of words.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a teaching chain, retained prey, covenantal hearing and obedience, then distortion and forgetting; I infer that the trained agents serve as an ironic image of transmission fidelity. A live alternative is that their retention remains only a technical hunting behavior with no comparison to human covenant failure.

changed_reading.before: Training displays human skill applied to useful animals.
changed_reading.after: Training mirrors an ethics of revelation: received teaching must be retained, enacted, and handed on without self-serving diversion, a fidelity the trained hunters display more cleanly than later human groups.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant mapping from the focus root for name to the root for a visible mark. It remains anchored to the exact name construction over a held object and clarifies provenance, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for naming, not as a replacement etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The name at index 23 is placed over the catch that has been held at index 20.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies a material analogy in which naming makes the catch's provenance and governing claim legible.
Vocal mention supplies the explicit act by which the identifying claim is made present.
The held catch supplies the transferred object on which provenance must remain visible before consumption.

changed_reading.before: Mentioning the name is only a required utterance.
changed_reading.after: Mentioning the name also behaves like a provenance mark on the handoff, preventing captured material from becoming anonymously self-owned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cross-domain move is surprising, but the focus branch explicitly couples eating and sexual union, and 5:5 immediately places reciprocal food permission beside protected marital access and its illicit alternatives. It remains anchored to the focus's good things, yet downstream prose must frame this only as parallel governance of appetites and must never assimilate persons to prey or possession.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The good things at index 8 open a branch that can pair eating with sexual union, while the focus governs taking food through training, holding, and naming.

activation_trace.role: The branch pairing the two bodily pleasures supplies the cross-domain bridge from eating to intimate appetite.
Taking food in a reciprocal social construction supplies the first appetite under lawful form.
Protection through contract or inviolability supplies the lawful form governing the second appetite.
Sexual release without a binding contract supplies the contrast in which appetite spills outside protective form.

changed_reading.before: The food ruling is isolated from the relationship ruling that follows.
changed_reading.after: The two ayat coordinate bodily appetites through lawful form: food passes through trained and named handoff, while intimacy passes through protective covenant rather than unbounded release.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This long-range cross-species foil is surprising, but it remains anchored to the focus's repeated teaching and trained holding and to the later sequence of commanded entry, turning back, and sitting out. Downstream prose should qualify it as a pericope-level irony, not claim that the narrative explicitly compares the community to hunting animals.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The taught hunting agents at indices 10-20 act on instruction and preserve its intended result.

activation_trace.role: Received knowledge supplies the training whose result becomes effective action.
Hunting training supplies agents that move outward under instruction rather than following appetite alone.
Holding supplies successful preservation of the intended result after obedient movement.
Entry into an interior supplies the commanded movement that the later human group refuses to enact.
Turning or returning supplies the warned reversal away from the commanded destination.
Sitting back from action supplies the terminal contrast to trained agents that enact instruction.

changed_reading.before: The trained hunters are subordinate tools in a food rule.
changed_reading.after: Within the wider pericope they become an ironic image of taught agency that moves and preserves, set against humans who receive direction but turn back and sit out.

strongest_changes: Permission became selective untying within a continuing covenant rather than appetite's blank authorization.
The contrast between 5:3 and 5:4 made lawful prey depend on an interruptible, traceable process that ends in disciplined handoff.
Training and holding became governance of force and faithful transmission, sharpened by restrained hands and the context's movement from covenantal hearing to distortion and forgetting.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses release, pedagogy, predation, inhibition, naming, and account into one transfer sequence; the context repeatedly reactivates those mechanics at legal, bodily, covenantal, social, and collective scales.
remaining_uncertainties: The binding-and-untying relation may be a deliberate material reversal, but it could also arise from adjacent legal diction.
The two-appetite parallel and the contrast between trained agents and seated refusers remain exploratory structural analogies rather than asserted interpretations.
The name-as-mark reading depends on a form-distant mapped root and should remain an analogy of provenance, not an etymological claim.
